newsitem.title: USA: US Mint buys 1.79 mln kg copper at avg $2.4620/kg.
newsitem.headline: US Mint buys 1.79 mln kg copper at avg $2.4620/kg.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said Tuesday that it bought a total of 1,790,000 kg of surplus copper in nine lots from three companies at an average price of $2.46120 per kg.
Gerald Metals sold 1,417,332 kg at an average price of $2.4606 per kg. Kataman Metals sold 53,000 kg at an average price of $2.5276 per kg. Ore & Chemical Co. sold 319,668 kg at $2.4666 per kg.
The Mint said the total sale price was $4,406,969.12.
